service.name: Corporate retreat entertainment in Breckenridge
service.serviceType: Live music for corporate retreats and incentive events
service.description: Live music for corporate retreats and private celebrations at Breckenridge venues, solo through quartet, planned for 9,600 feet.

faqs.q: Does 9,600 feet change what the band costs?
faqs.a: Time, not money. The corridor travel line is the same one Vail and Beaver Creek carry. What changes at Breckenridge is the plan: the generous end of the load-in window, a longer sound check, paced sets and retunes between them. There is no altitude line on the quote.

Reported at 55 dBA by day and 50 after hours in residential zones, 70 and 65 in commercial, with the town manager able to permit above them. We could not reach the code text directly, so we treat your venue's number as governing and build the night under it. Sources are cited on our mountain corridor page.

faqs.q: How does load-in work at Ten Mile Station?
faqs.a: Time, not money. The corridor travel line is the same one Vail and Beaver Creek carry. What changes at Breckenridge is the plan: the generous end of the load-in window, a longer sound check, paced sets and retunes between them. There is no altitude line on the quote.

faqs.q: How late can the music run?
faqs.a: To the curfew as written, and we want the time at booking. The last twenty minutes are shaped to land on it, and time added before the cut-off bills at the same hourly figure as every earlier hour, in 30-minute increments. There is no overtime rate.
